prompt.text: Full-body lookbook photography of a model standing in the center of a rain-slicked Shibuya crossing at twilight. The composition is a sharp medium-wide shot using a 35mm lens, capturing the vibrant neon signs of the background blurred into a soft bokeh of pinks and cyans. The mood is urban and fast-paced, with a subtle film grain characteristic of Portra 400. The image features a clean vertical layout suitable for a fashion magazine, with the text 'NEO-URBAN' subtly embossed in the corner in a minimalist sans-serif font. No brand logos are visible.
